drcExposure.question: How much non-Chinese refined cobalt imported by the US still relies on DRC feed?
drcExposure.method: Volume-weighted (Sayari kg shares of the non-China tier-1 nodes) average of each node's DRC-hydroxide tier-2 share; upper bound sets eu-hub 0.5, eu-ind 0.68 (Finland facet), other 0.4, jp 0.05.
drcExposure.answer: About 12% (up to ~26%) of non-Chinese US-bound refined cobalt in Sayari BOLs depends on DRC feed. The figure is low because Japan/SMM (45% of volume) runs on Indonesian matte and Philippine HPAL sulphide, and Canada/Madagascar/Morocco run on their own ore. The DRC-exposed non-Chinese supply is concentrated in European refiners (Kokkola: 68% of tagged Finnish feed from DRC-corridor ports) and trader stock. China's own refiners are about 64% DRC-fed, so the Feb-2025 ban hits China first and Europe second.

comparison: Sayari weight totals (t, all nodes): 2023 1416.1, 2024 2245.2, 2025 2555.7, 2026 Jan-Oct 2036.1. Japan node 296.9/827.6/1252.7 t (2023-25); China+HK node 167.2/545.0/433.5 t. trade.json Comtrade HS 810520 (USD, only CHN/JPN/KOR/MEX partners): Japan 60955091/52167693/60197057, China 964994/2060847/1791553 (China share of 810520 ~1.6/3.8/2.9%). Direction agrees: Japan is the dominant single supplier in both. Levels differ: Comtrade covers only four partners and misses Belgium/Netherlands, Canada, Norway, Finland and the DRC corridor entirely, while Sayari counts Antwerp/Rotterdam trader lots and European powder makers separately, so Sayari's China share (~15% of kg) is higher than Comtrade's but Japan's (~45%) lower. Neither source shows Norway as a departure country: Nikkelverk metal reaches the US via Antwerp/Rotterdam warehouses (2 brand-tagged lots). Sayari bills of lading are partial coverage; tonnes are not a full US import total (USGS puts US cobalt imports near 10 kt/yr).

caveats: Measure is shipment weight in kg (net weight from the description where given, else gross weight on the bill), not contained cobalt; cathode/briquette lots are ~99.8% Co but powders/alloy powders (eu-ind, other) are not.

Coverage is partial: Sayari holds US import bills of lading (ocean freight) plus some partner export records. Mean monthly total is ~179 t, about 20% of USGS-scale US imports; air freight and many lots are missing.
Zeros mean 'no recorded shipment', not measured zero imports; months with shipments per node are in raw.monthsWithShipments (19-40 of 46). ca-af is two merged sparse corridors.

No Norway or Finland nodes: Nikkelverk cobalt reaches the US via Antwerp/Rotterdam warehouses (eu-hub) and Kokkola lots appear only undated (K+N Finland) or under HS 282200, which is not in the series.
eu-hub is a warehouse/trader node: only 16 of 150 Benelux rows name a brand; tier-2 shares there extrapolate a small tagged sample to the untagged lots.

China-departure lots include non-Chinese brands (SMM, Murrin Murrin, Ambatovy) re-exported from bonded warehouses, so the cn node is not purely Chinese-refined metal; conversely Chinese-refined metal is likely hidden in eu-hub, eu-ind and other (modelled via tier2 cn-refiners, assumed).

Tier-2 'reported' shares are shipment-count shares from Sayari import facets (CHN, FIN, JPN) or brand counts, not tonnage or contained cobalt; DRC origin is proxied by departure from ZAF/MOZ/TZA/COD/ZMB ports. Finnish facet rows end 2025-04 (pre-quota).

The DRC export ban (22-Feb-2025, extended June 2025, quotas from Oct-2025, per Tavily sources) is a 2025 regime change; Benelux and China lots both thin out in late 2025-2026, which will drive covariance.
Sherritt (Cuban Moa feed) cobalt cannot enter the US under the embargo; no Sherritt lots found. New Providence Metals Sales (Nassau) shipped from Canada only in 2022 (outside window).
Japan node includes Busan-transhipped lots assigned by shipper/receiver/brand; 22 weightless Japan-export-source rows were treated as duplicates and dropped.
Comtrade in trade.json omits the US-DRC corridor and all European partners; it cannot be used to scale these series.
